title: DevKit Project Version Pins
description: Project-level version pins (version-management.md §5). Declares package requirements using the same policy vocabulary as profiles. Introduced as a new schema — the profile schema is unchanged. DevKit suggests changes when entering a project; it never auto-applies them.

name.description: Human-readable project name shown in the review step.

package_id.description: Stable package ID as published in the catalog.

required.description: A required pin that cannot resolve fails the plan; an optional one is reported as unresolved.

version.description: Concrete version. Required when version_policy is exact; an exact project pin always wins over profile/global policy.

channel.description: Channel name. Required when version_policy is channel.

packages.description: Package pin selections. Package IDs must be unique within a project.
